pipelines.name: CI

steps.name: Create and push git tag
steps.run:
VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
if git ls-remote --tags origin | grep -q "refs/tags/v${VERSION}$"; then
  echo "Tag v${VERSION} already exists, skipping"
else
  git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
  git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
  git tag -a "v${VERSION}" -m "Release v${VERSION}"
  git push origin "v${VERSION}"
fi

steps.name: Publish package
steps.run: pnpm publish -r --no-git-checks || echo "Version already published, skipping"

steps.name: Install mcp-publisher
steps.run: curl -L "https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/releases/latest/download/mcp-publisher_$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')_$(uname -m | sed 's/x86_64/amd64/;s/aarch64/arm64/').tar.gz" | tar xz mcp-publisher

steps.name: Sync server.json version from package.json
steps.run:
VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const s = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('server.json')); s.version = '$VERSION'; s.packages[0].version = '$VERSION'; fs.writeFileSync('server.json', JSON.stringify(s, null, 2) + '\n')"
